name: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Pro Train: SW1500 Loco Pack 4
summary: The EMD SW1500 is a versatile 1,500 hp diesel-electric switcher. This DLC features five highly detailed variants with realistic physics, sounds, and advanced features. Included liveries: TP&W Red, CN, UP, CP, and MRL 2. Perfect for yard switching and short road freight duties.
